channel.title: Tayyab Ilyas: Engineering notes
channel.description: MCP connectors, multi-agent systems and self-hosted AI infrastructure, from systems in production.

item.title: MCP connectors are the App Store moment for AI
item.description: Why MCP connectors for Claude and other assistants look like the 2008 App Store: a standard socket, a directory, and builders shipping capabilities into an AI that millions already use. Lessons from shipping six connectors.

item.title: How to give a Grok Bot tasks when there is no API
item.description: xAI's Grok Bot has no API for sending messages. Here is a working pattern that lets Claude or any automation delegate tasks to Grok Bots through an inbox and outbox on their shared computer, with the exact standing instruction to paste.

item.title: Claude custom connector with Google sign-in: fixing redirect_uri_mismatch
item.description: Building a remote MCP server for claude.ai with Google OAuth and FastMCP? The redirect_uri_mismatch error almost always means the wrong callback was registered, or on the wrong Google client. The two redirect URIs explained, with working code and checks.

item.title: Claude, Grok and Codex on one build: one plans, one writes, one reviews
item.description: A real build where Claude designed and planned, the Grok CLI wrote the code test-first, and the Codex CLI reviewed every task. What the reviewer caught, the incident that changed my rules, and when this beats Claude Code vs Codex comparisons.

item.title: Disposable Proxmox VMs as a sandbox for Claude Code, Codex and Gemini
item.description: A sandbox for AI coding agents that is a whole virtual machine: cloned from a golden image in seconds, on a walled network behind an allow-list proxy, created by Claude through an MCP connector and destroyed automatically when its time runs out.

item.title: An SSH MCP server for AI agents: reverse tunnels and the three ways they break
item.description: Giving Claude a shell on a remote machine through an SSH MCP server and a reverse tunnel. Three failure modes that cost me real time: a tunnel that loops back to itself, host keys that change on every restart, and an OpenSSH penalty that locks the connector out.
